To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a superconducting link with Bi-2212 conductor has higher AC loss than a link with YBCO conductor, and that the YBCO conductor is able to limit the fault current in a very short time.
the design of a 20 kV 2 kA 2-phase superconducting link with 1 m length is feasible and the AC losses are low enough to allow the operation of the power link with liquid nitrogen cooling.

the design of the functional model is based on the following considerations: the conductor should be Y-123 film; the limiting phase should use the Y-123 film as well; the normal operation should use the Bi-2212 conductor; and the normal operation should have a low AC loss.

the design of the functional model, the design of the cryogenic system, and the design of the control and protection system.
the design and performance evaluation of the SUPERPOLI power link.
design, manufacturing, characterization, and testing of the conductor, the cryostat, and the power link.
